# RyuisLabs

> Deterministic Systems Engineering Studio · On-Device AI Vision & Privacy-Preserving State Verification

RyuisLabs (류이즈랩스) is a systems engineering studio established in 2026, founded and operated by ryuis in Seoul, South Korea. We reject randomness, superficial trends, and emotional vagueness, focusing on causality-driven software architecture, zero-knowledge principles, and on-device machine intelligence.

## Flagship System: RYUis : STATUS
A privacy-preserving state verification engine that objectively measures and proves human focus and execution without surveillance:
- **Module 01 (Focus Vision)**: Eye tracking via front camera calculates Pure Focus Time. Video never leaves the user device.
- **Module 02 (Physical Vision)**: Pose estimation measures precise joint angles to count verified exercise repetitions instead of self-reporting.
- **Module 03 (Zero-Knowledge Log)**: Raw video frames are discarded immediately after inference. Only tamper-proof encrypted stat vectors are retained.

## Product Portfolio & Utilities
- **SeedVault** (`/landing/seedvault`): Military-grade offline password & seed vault with Argon2id key derivation and AES-256-GCM encryption. Zero network access, biometric lock, zero telemetry. Available on Google Play (`com.ryuislabs.seedvault`).
- **MemoFlow** (`/landing/memoflow`): Instant single-purpose draft & markdown capture utility with local storage and multi-format export (HTML, Markdown, JSON).
- **ABILITY: Gravity & Time** (`/landing/ability/gravity-time`): Sci-fi themed focus & pomodoro timer based on deterministic causality and background resilience.
- **ABILITY: DaoXin** (`/landing/ability/daoxin`): Eastern philosophy and Taoist discipline companion for mental clarity, habit mastery, and internal cultivation.
